incident: Asked by Shawn 2026-11-11 whether the Pyrodrone items can be bought on Amazon or cheaper there. Not found on Amazon: CNHL 1300 mAh 4S 130C (searches 'CNHL Black Series 1300mAh 4S 130C XT60' and 'CNHL 1300mAh 4S 130C XT60 lipo' returned the 1500 mAh 4S and 1300 mAh 6S packs only), a 16 x 250 mm strap (16 x 200 and 16 x 300 five-packs at $8.99 against $3.98 for two). SH1.0 cable kits on Amazon $15.99 to $19.99 against $7.99. Other brands' 1300 mAh 4S packs (Zeee 120C $26.39, Ovonic) were not checked for size. Nothing carted or removed.
